_howto: Owner: edit on GitHub (pencil icon), then Commit changes — the site updates in ~1-2 min. One {...} per gem, separated by commas. Fields: name, area, cat (filter chip e.g. Beach/Nature/Culture), blurb (one short line), img (file name in site/images, upload via Add file > Upload files; WebP ~400px wide best), w/h (image pixel size), credit (photographer or Duban), lic/licUrl/src only for Wikimedia Commons photos. Keep quotes and commas valid.
